headline: No API changes break the bot today; the ideas add weekend rules to the brief, show when each coin's funding is charged and how often, and split your results into coins from the morning list versus coins you chased.

ideas.title: Weekend rules in the Saturday and Sunday brief
ideas.why: Weekend crypto volume is now only about 13% of the week, so books on small coins are thinner and wicks run further. On Sat/Sun the brief could switch to weekend rules: fewer trades, a lower leverage cap, and low-volume movers hidden from Clean picks.

ideas.title: Funding clock on each scanner card
ideas.why: Some coins charge funding every 4h or 1h, not 8h, and at 40× one 0.1% payment costs 4% of your margin. Show "funding 0.10%/4h, in 12 min" on each card and flag high funding about to settle, using data the scanner already fetches plus one free call.

ideas.title: On-list vs off-list trades
ideas.why: Research finds people mostly buy what grabs their attention: big movers and volume spikes. Save each morning's scanner picks and split your PnL and revenge trades by coins on the list vs off it, so you can see what chasing off-plan coins costs you.
